author: commandershaxx
quote: I miss how it used to be all about crime and less about sex and sim like features. I had to ask for a refund. I don’t understand why or how this is so critically acclaimed. I feal cheated out of my money and time.

author: commandershaxx
quote: Relived my childhood all over again. I’m ready to play it over and over again. Such a gorgeous looking game on the switch 2. Easily my favorite game of all time. If you enjoyed the N64 version you are in for a TREAT. The game runs smooth, it looks fantastic and the music is the icing on that big beautiful cake.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
